mechanism: Methylprednisolone may increase hemolytic risk in primaquine-treated patients by enhancing oxidative stress and suppressing immune compensation mechanisms, particularly in G6PD-deficient individuals.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia signs (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue); ensure G6PD status is known; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose and consider alternative antimalarial if high-dose corticosteroids required.
